title: Start a rumour
text: Everyone writes something silly to start their notebook.

title: Pass it on
text: Notebooks get passed round. The next person draws what they read, the one after guesses the drawing, and so on.

title: The reveal
text: On the TV, each owner flips through their notebook page by page. Everyone throws reactions at the screen.

scene.tv: my cat runs a bank ➜ ... ➜ tiger robs a shop
